metadata.title: AI Automation Pricing
metadata.description: Explore flexible Risein AI pricing for workflow audits automation setup AI assistants integrations and ongoing business support.

hero.title: Start with one useful automation and grow from there.
hero.description: Choose the level of support that matches your current business needs. Every project begins with understanding the process before recommending tools or building anything.

audit.name: Workflow Audit
audit.description: A focused review of one business process to identify repetitive work delays errors and realistic automation opportunities.

starter.name: Starter Automation
starter.description: A practical first automation for a small repetitive task that currently consumes time or requires frequent manual follow-up.

growth.name: Growth Automation
growth.description: A connected automation system for businesses that need several tools processes and team activities to work together.

support.name: Ongoing Improvement
support.description: Continuous monitoring maintenance and improvement for businesses already using automation or AI-supported workflows.

included.title: More than simply connecting applications.
included.description: Every Risein AI implementation is designed around reliability clarity and the people who will use the system.
included.discoveryDescription: We understand the current workflow the people involved and the result the business needs.

included.handoverDescription: You receive clear guidance explaining how the system works and how your team should use it.

comparison.title: Which plan fits your business?
comparison.auditDescription: You know something is inefficient but are not yet sure what should be automated or where to begin.
comparison.starterDescription: You have one small clear process such as lead collection reminders data entry or customer follow-up.
comparison.growthDescription: Your process crosses several tools includes important business rules or affects multiple team members.
comparison.supportDescription: You already use automated systems and need dependable maintenance monitoring and gradual improvements.

faq.title: Frequently asked questions
faq.answer1: The listed amounts are starting prices. Your final quotation depends on the number of workflow steps integrations users and technical requirements.
faq.question2: Do I need to know which automation tool to use?
faq.answer2: No. We recommend the tools only after understanding your workflow budget existing systems and future needs.
faq.question3: Will I need to pay monthly fees for other platforms?
faq.answer3: Some automation AI database messaging or CRM platforms may charge separate subscription or usage fees. These costs are explained before implementation.
faq.question4: Can we begin with a small project?
faq.answer4: Yes. Starting with one useful workflow is often the safest way to prove value learn from real usage and expand gradually.
faq.question5: Do you work with existing automation systems?
faq.answer5: Yes. We can review repair improve document or extend workflows that were created previously by your team or another provider.
faq.question6: How long does a project take?
faq.answer6: A small automation may take one to two weeks. Larger connected systems may require several weeks depending on access integrations testing and feedback.

notice.title: Important pricing note
notice.description: Prices shown are starting estimates and may exclude third-party software subscriptions usage charges taxes and unusually complex custom development. You will receive a clear scope and quotation before paid work begins.

cta.title: Not sure which option fits your workflow?
cta.description: Start with a free conversation. We will examine the process and recommend the smallest sensible solution rather than selling unnecessary complexity.
